Victor, your Thor P2 is packed and reserved at our Chattanooga warehouse, still sitting on hold. The only thing holding it is that receiving hasn't booked your returned BS-2 in yet, even though your tracking shows it delivered there on the 20th. That's our delay, not yours, and I'm sorry you've had to chase it twice.

I've put it straight to the team with that delivery date so they can log the unit and release your shipment. Stay in the chat if you can, otherwise the update comes to your email.
